title: Quirky German Scotch Bonnet Pudding
description: A festive German dessert featuring scotch bonnet peppers, with a nutty and glassy-jelly texture, low in fat and perfect for special occasions.
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1/4 cup of cold water and let it sit for 5 minutes to soften.
In a medium saucepan, combine the almond milk, honey, vanilla extract, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt, and heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and add the softened gelatin, stirring until it is fully dissolved.
Add the diced scotch bonnet peppers to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish and refrigerate until set, about 3 hours.
Just before serving, sprinkle the chopped almonds over the top of the pudding.
Cut the pudding into squares and serve chilled.
